hero.subTagline: 4+ years at Sidmach Technologies as Frontend Lead & Scrum Master, turning complex problems into clean, working software. I care about the craft, the team, and the outcome.
hero.availabilityText: Open to new opportunities · Lagos, Nigeria

about.headline: The developer who also asks "but why are we building this?"
paragraphs: Hello, I'm Simi,short for Victoria Similejesu Ariyo. I'm a Frontend Lead, Scrum Master, and product-minded developer based in Lagos, Nigeria. I joined Sidmach Technologies through the NYSC programme and never left, because the problems kept getting more interesting.

My work lives at the intersection of engineering and leadership. I write React and TypeScript, run sprints, mentor junior developers, manage stakeholder expectations, and still care deeply about whether the button label is exactly right. I believe the best engineers understand the business problem as well as the technical one.

I'm currently pursuing an MBA at Ahmadu Bello University not to leave engineering, but to get sharper at the parts of the job that happen in rooms without laptops. I also hold Azure Fundamentals and Azure AI Fundamentals certifications.
about.beyond: Outside of engineering, I have a deep interest in the events and entertainment space.I love exploring what a thoughtfully designed product in that industry could look like. I also conceived ScopeAI, an idea for an AI-assisted feature scoping tool inspired by the manual scoping process I use at work.

howIWork.title: I scope before I code
howIWork.body: Every feature I've built started with a question: are we solving the right problem? I use a structured, manual scoping process at Sidmach; working through requirements, edge cases, and stakeholder alignment before writing a single line. It's not glamorous, but it's why our sprints don't collapse halfway through.

howIWork.title: I lead people, not just tasks
howIWork.body: As Scrum Master and Frontend Lead, I've learned that the job isn't moving tickets across a board; it's making sure every person on the team understands the why, has what they need, and feels safe raising blockers early. Velocity follows trust.

howIWork.title: I write code that future-me can read
howIWork.body: Readable, well-structured code is a team sport. I champion component documentation, and consistent naming conventions. I've onboarded new hires and mentored interns;clean code is how knowledge transfers.

howIWork.title: I own outcomes, not just deliverables
howIWork.body: Shipping a feature isn't done when the PR merges. I track whether it's being used, whether it broke something downstream, and whether it actually solved the problem it was built for. I close the loop.

shipped.title: ApprovalFlowV2
shipped.description: A multi-role approval workflow system built for Sidmach Technologies, handling document routing across departments with role-based permissions, audit trails, and real-time status updates. Reduced manual processing steps significantly across multiple business units.
shipped.outcome: Eliminated manual document routing across 3 business units — what took days now takes minutes.

shipped.title: Enterprise Appraisal System
shipped.description: Full-cycle appraisal management platform with a template-vs-instance model, configurable dispute tiers, per-cycle toggle settings, and protected vs optional tier logic. Designed the architecture and built the frontend end-to-end.
shipped.outcome: Replaced a spreadsheet-based appraisal process with a fully configurable, dispute-aware platform.

shipped.title: WAEC-EduStat
shipped.description: A data analytics dashboard for education sector insights visualising student performance, institutional metrics, and trend analysis based off the WAEC data. Built within the Data Fusion Business Unit at Sidmach.
shipped.outcome: Deloped an analytics platform that provides diverse educational insights for different demography of users

shipped.title: Youthplus
shipped.description: Contributed to the Youthplus platform as part of the Sidmach engineering team working on frontend feature development, component architecture, and sprint delivery across multiple cycles.
shipped.outcome: Delivered consistent sprint contributions across multiple cycles

shipped.title: Chef Zee Admin
shipped.description: Admin dashboard built for the Chef Zee product managing orders, users, products order fulfillment and operational data. Delivered the frontend end-to-end including data tables, role management, and reporting views.
shipped.outcome: Shipped a full admin dashboard from scratch including order management, transaction management, user roles, and reporting in one place.

inProgress.title: Celeb Wedding Platform
inProgress.description: A wedding celebration web platform with QR code guest access, photo gallery, food menu, gifting wishlist, and interactive games. Built with Next.js 14 and Supabase, designed to be a reusable template for future events.
inProgress.outcome: Building a personalised guest experience platform includingQR auth, dynamic menus, and interactive wedding games.

inProgress.title: ScopeAI
inProgress.description: An AI-assisted feature scoping tool inspired by the manual scoping process I've developed and use at Sidmach. The goal is to help product teams stop building the wrong thing confidently.
inProgress.outcome: Turning a manual scoping methodology I use at Sidmach into a tool any product team can run independently.

inProgress.title: DevDocs AI
inProgress.description: An AI-powered documentation generator planned as a flagship personal project to explore the intersection of developer tooling and large language models.
inProgress.outcome: Exploring AI-generated process documentation — reducing the manual overhead of keeping internal docs current.

contact.heading: Let's build something worth building.
contact.subheading: I'm open to Frontend Lead, Scrum Master, and product-minded developer roles. If you're looking for someone who ships clean code and keeps a team aligned — let's talk.
